code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, and mild renal impairment (elevated creatinine). There are also mild monocytosis and basophilia. Liver function and electrolytes are within normal limits. Findings suggest possible bone marrow suppression or systemic illness with hypoxia and renal involvement; clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
